label: Two-contest model: Herder–Schlözer representation versus Gatterer–Schlözer ownership of method
notes: Current evidence suggests two adjacent controversy surfaces. Herder–Schlözer directly contests fact-density, strict history, table/system and graphical pedagogical delegation; Gatterer–Schlözer contests teaching competition, Plan, priority and ownership of Universalgeschichte method. Colour may connect them only if the same ordering/media operations are shown to be part of the actors' contested method.
